publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Food poisoning is a serious problem that affects thousands of people every year. Contaminated food is usually detectable by odor. The stranger odors of food poisoning are often caused by microorganism that release some gases via its metabolism. Our interest is the improvement of polyaniline and silver nanoparticles composites to achieve developing the off-flavor food gas sensor. PANI and silver nanoparticles (AgNPs)-PANI nanocomposite, including mixing synthesized and core shell synthesized nanocomposite. The AgNPs-PANI nanocomposites successfully synthesized by in-situ chemical polymerization approach. The formation of metallic silver nanoparticles as well as its presence in the nanocomposite were confirmed by UV-Vis spectrometry and SEM analysis. Sensing response of mixing synthesized nanocomposite revealed excellent correlation between sensing response and the various ethanol concentrations at room temperature.

articleTitle: Robust Control of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of stabilization for uncertain nonlinear systems by neural network controller. We prove a robust stability condition for neural network control systems whose parameters are uncertain. It shows how to model uncertainties in the case of additive or multiplicative parametric variations. The proof is based on the Lyapunov stability theorem can be treated as the equality constraint optimization problem and can be imposed in training processes to guarantee the stability of the continuous closed-loop system. Two control strategies are explored: model-reference control and inverse control are employed to determine the weights of the controllers. The efficiency of proposed scheme is shown through the simulation of a non-affine nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Short Term Analysis of PV System Performance in Different Areas of Thailand
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This study presents the short-period analysis of PV performance in accordance with IEC 61724 standard. Both PV system plants are located in Udon Thani and Mae Hong Son provinces in Thailand. The PV capacity of Udon Thani plant is 790.4 kWp and the one in Mae Hong Son has the capacity of 642.2 kWp. The weather and operating data from 1st to 31st December 2018 was analyzed. The amount of energy generation depends on the weather effects, such as the uniformity of irradiation and the temperature of the PV module. The average irradiation at Udon Thani plant is 798.32 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/day and Mae Hong Son plant is 749.77 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/day. Average PV module temperature at Udon Thani plant is 50.65 oC and Mae Hong Son plant is 53.35 °C. The performance ratio demonstrated the ratio of the produced energy relative to the amount of irradiation. The average PR at Udon Thani plant is 84.43 % and Mae Hong Son plant is 64.55%. The amount of irradiation and the high module temperature cause a reduction in power generation.

articleTitle: Kappa Number Prediction of Pulp Digester Using LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: A digester, one of the major units of Kraft process, has a function for conversion of wood into wood pulp. It is controlled by monitoring Kappa number with nonlinear reaction and has a long resident time. This paper aims to present the prediction of kappa number in pulp digester in advance for 1-3 hours by using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network. The structures of LSTM inputs consists of effective alkali, temperature, and outlet lignin content. The prediction has been developed with nonlinear simulations of digester reactions. The results reveal that a kappa prediction can be predicted in advance for 1, 2 and 3 hours with percentages of error 1.1, 1.9 and 2.9 respectively. It could be beneficial for an operator to decide on feedforward compensation before it is out of control.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Robust Control of A2DOF with Push-Pull Convert for Renewable Energy Application
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: If duty ratio of push-pull converter is changed, the dynamic characteristics are variable more, that is, the push-pull converter has nonlinear characteristics. We proposed of response and dynamic load change of push-pull converter. This same time makes a variation of the output voltage at sudden change of input voltages and loads Experimental studies the digital PI and A2DOF control. In the push-pull converter used conventional controller cannot be adapted to parameter change. In this paper, an A2DOF (Approximate 2 Degree Of Freedom) robust digital controller for suppress the change of step response characteristics and variations of output voltages in the load sudden changes is proposed. The controller is implemented by a DSC dsPIC30F2010. It is demonstrated from experiments that the push-pull converter is realizable.

articleTitle: Uplink Wireless Powered Communications of Rate-adaptive IoT Nodes with Intermittent Energy Source
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: We optimize the uplink outage probability and throughput of the cellular IoT network, where the IoT nodes in the cell are rate-adaptive. The IoT nodes do not have their own energy source, and the base station (BS) has to wirelessly transfer energy to the IoT node. The BS does not have a power supply, and solely rely on the battery, charged by intermittent solar power. The outage probability minimization and throughput maximization are done by the optimization framework based on Markov Decision Process (MDP). Since the intermittent solar power can make the BS run out of battery, we also propose the cooperative BS scheme, where two BSs share a battery to reduce the risk of empty battery. The numerical results show that the cooperative BS scheme achieves lower outage probability than the independent BS scheme, but the throughput is marginally higher.

articleTitle: Optimal Hybrid Renewable Energy System Considering Maximum Profit from Electricity Sale
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to determine the proportion of different renewable energy systems which are combined to be a hybrid renewable energy system. In addition, the daily operation of each renewable energy system can be determined. The results are aimed to be an optimal hybrid renewable energy system which provides the maximum profit from electricity sale throughout the project lifetime. Since the capacity and operation characteristics of renewable energy systems depend on their limited renewable energy resources in the vicinity of project locations and the characteristic of generators, the analysis considers the constraints along with investment cost, fuel cost, operation and management cost and financial parameters such as inflation rate, discount rate and interest. Furthermore, this paper considers various renewable energy sources consisting of solar, wind, biomass, biogas and RDF which are combinable to be thirteen combinations of hybrid renewable energy systems. Thailand's renewable energy data, generation characteristics and financial parameter data are used in the simulation. The results provide the most appropriate proportion of different renewable energy systems and daily operation of each combination of hybrid renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Wideband Direction-of-Arrival Estimation with Cross-Sample Matching Technique on L-Shaped Microphone Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents a novel two-dimensional wideband direction-of-arrival estimation method for an L-shaped microphone array model. Our study provides an alternative but highly efficient way to construct a universal cross-correlation matrix in the wideband subspace method by using all samples from both identical and distinct domains of frequencies. To avoid computational burden caused by intensive use the sample from all domains, the optimal mathematical model of received signal for all frequency is derived and proposed without loss of generality. Numerical simulations show that the performance of proposed method can be especially effective over range with a more favorable signal-to-noise ratio. This advantage makes it suitable for practical implementation in acoustic signal processing.

articleTitle: Iterative PID Regulatory Control Design using Gradient Estimate of LQG evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Iterative Feedback Tuning (IFT) is a kind of datadriven controller parameter tuning that estimate a gradient vector of a prescribed cost criterion. Using the estimated gradient vector controller parameters are updated by way of the steepest decent algorithm. The present work proposes an IFT for a discrete-time, velocity type of PID regulatory controller that optimizes a Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) cost criterion. The main contribution of the present work is to extend our previous work to an LQG cost criterion from output variance evaluation. The proposed method inherits the feature from the previous work that avoids the second experiment where the first experimental data is fed to the closed-loop system as a reference signal and provides an estimation method for a gradient vector of the sum of output variance and input variance. In detail, the present work provides an estimate of sensitivity function for an estimate of a gradient vector of the variance of input signal while the previous work provided an estimate of complementary sensitivity function for an estimate of gradient vector of output signal. The effectiveness of the proposed method is shown through a numerical simulation result.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Multiple Protocols Supported Embedded Gateway for Industrial Networked Electrical Metering Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of multiple protocols supported gateway for industrial networked electrical metering systems. There are two main parts proposed in this paper. Firstly, the flexible hardware design and development of smart meter that allow users to customize the communication protocols. Secondly, the firmware design and implementation techniques for the multiple protocols supported gateway. The smart meters used in this research are divided into three groups. The first group uses WebSockets as communication protocol. The second group utilizes MQTT protocol. The third group uses Modbus serial and Modbus TCP. All meters can measure all required electrical parameters, e.g., voltage, current, watt-hour, power factor and many other. The gateway can handle all required protocols and it can perform all communication channels concurrently. In addition, a plug-and-play algorithm is also mentioned. The firmware of the meters and the gateway are implemented based on Free-RTOS with C language to maintain speed and system performance. All communication protocols of the smart meters and gateway are implemented follow industrial standards. Therefore, the gateway and all groups of meters can be deployed to all standard industrial networks. In experiments, the gateway is connected to the internet to serve external requests from clients. The meters and gateway are evaluated in various possible conditions. The experimental results show that the meters can measure the desired electrical parameters and exchange their data correctly as expected. The gateway can perform all protocols and can respond to all incoming requests from clients concurrently and correctly.

articleTitle: Evaluation of MQTT and CoAP for Vehicle Traffic Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Nowadays, the traffic monitoring on the roads or highways usually used a radio-based sensor that know as radar. And these sensors must be installed on road side or gantry. One of all problem for these sensors are must be only installed in the focus point this problem leading to uncover range of monitoring. In this paper purpose to use the internet of Things (IoT) technology for traffic monitoring. we evaluate two popular IoT protocols are MQTT and CoAP. In our experiments we explained the result and benefits for using IoT technology with traffic monitoring.

articleTitle: Simulation of PV System Using EMTP-ATPDraw
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents the modelling and simulation of the Photovoltaic (PV) system using Electro-Magnetic Transient Program, EMTP-ATPDraw. The PV generator model including PV characteristic curves, filter and inverter models are also presented. The currents from PV behind the inverter with different loads are also compared. The simplified PV generator model including inverter and filter models proposed in this paper can be applied for studying PV system in transient and steady state. Moreover, the complicated PV model can be added and developed to analyze the complex systems for the future work both for transient and dynamic studies.

articleTitle: Drawing as a Basic Ability of Design Students in Thinking Visual and Understanding of Form Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This research is to find out how someone who wants to become a designer but not through the process of selecting drawing skills in design study programs. Someone who is able to draw well, with the logic of form using sketch techniques to realist forms with the logic of perspective for objects whether reflecting intelligence and creativity in dealing with design problems by design students. What is the basic ability of someone who decides to study in the design field? The logic of the form outlined in the picture is important. Whether the inability to draw will be an obstacle in the learning process in the design study program. Product design is one branch of design science that requires students to be able to express their ideas in the form of images and convey them to others. In addition to expressing ideas, students are required to record objects with pictures and sketches directly to understand what they see, both the form and logic of their perspectives and functions. In the design education curriculum, in the first year it is compulsory to take the Basic Drawing and Technical Drawing courses and Nirmana 1 (two-dimensional basic design) and Nirmana 2 (three-dimensional basic design) courses. In the profession of designers, students or young people who want to become designers, in my opinion; knowledge and drawing skills are very important, even must be owned by a designer or prospective designer. Some state universities and art and design institutions in Indonesia, prospective students always go through drawing tests, while most of them go to private universities, not through drawing tests. In this study, I made observations on several high school students who were predicted as prospective design students and for first-year product design students and students in the second year. The subjects observed in students in the product design study program are students who have never been through a drawing test received in a product design study program. Drawing is not a hobby or talent, but drawing is an ability and a way of observing objects and visual language to convey ideas.

articleTitle: Reduction of Ambipolar Conduction in Centrally Aligned PNPN-DG TFET
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, a novel 2D TFET with centrally aligned source pocket doping has been proposed and its performance metrics have been explored through simulations. The symmetric double gate TFET structure is incorporated with a centrally aligned heavily doped pocket region at the source end. This structural modification improves source tunnelling, resulting in higher ION/IOFF ratio and reduced ambipolarity, as compared to conventional planar TFETs. In order to study the performance characteristics, the gate metal length has been varied-24 nm, 14 nm and 7 nm. HfO2 has been used as the gate oxide material. The three resulting structural variations are compared to obtain the most optimized structure. All 2D simulations were performed on Silvaco, Atlas.

articleTitle: Image Processing for Quality Control in Manufacturing Process
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: The quality assurance process is function of bringing computers into quality control in place of the factory staff. The objective of this research is to study the feasibility for finding to the latest ideas for development in quality control system of Digital Video Display (DVD) inspection in the industrial process. The disadvantage of conventional method that used human inspections are error-prone, take a long time inspection per unit and others. This frame work based on the digital image processing technique for automatically quality inspection. Image processing involves changing the nature of an image in order to either; 1) Improve its pictorials information for human interpretation, 2) Renders it more suitable for autonomous machine perception. This research shall be concerned with digital image processing, which involves using a computer to change the nature of digital image. It is necessary to realizes that these two aspects represent two separate but equally importance aspect of image processing. The experimental results the system is able to perfect substitute to conventional method that used human inspection. Human error, inspection timing, quality control inspector and other costs reducing are the benefit of this research. (Employees: error-detection rate =0.015%, time of checking (piece) =10s), The System: error-detection rate =0.001%, time of checking (piece) =6s).

articleTitle: Electric Field Minimization using Optimal Phase Arrangement Techniques for MEA Overhead Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In order to minimize the electric field generated by Metropolitan Electricity Authority (MEA) overhead power transmission lines, the optimal phase arrangement techniques were applied for 3-circuits overhead power transmission lines (69/230 KV). In this paper, the mathematical model was designed using a MATLAB program which validated by comparing the simulated results with the measured results where the South Thonburi power transmission lines at Rama 2 Road (outbound side) were evaluated with the same conditions. Finally, it can be concluded that the optimal phase arrangement techniques can minimize the generated electric field lowering than that of the limitation given by the World Health organization.

articleTitle: Dissolved Gas Analysis of Liquid Insulation under AC and Impulse Breakdown Voltage Tests
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper represents the study of dissolved gas analysis in mineral oil compared with natural ester (FR3) under AC and impulse breakdown voltage tests. Liquid insulation was heated at 60°C with 200 mbar for 12 hours. Liquid test samples were divided into three groups. The first group was tested with AC voltage using the spherical electrodes with the gap distance of 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0 mm. The AC test procedure was in accordant with IEC 60156. The second and the third group of liquid samples was tested with standard positive lightning impulse and standard negative lightning impulse voltage using the needle - sphere electrode with the distance of 10, 15, and 20 mm. The impulse test procedure was according to IEC 60897. Testing experiments were performed 5, 10, and 15 times consecutively for each test sample. Then dissolved gas analysis of each test sample was performed. From the test results, the type of breakdown voltage and the number of breakdowns effected on the quantity of the dissolved gas in the liquid insulation.

articleTitle: Convergence Performance Evaluation of MSF-Based LMS Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This article analyzes the mean convergence (MC), and the mean square convergence (MSC) of a least mean square (LMS) multiple sub-filter (MSF) based adaptive filter for correlated Gaussian data under an independent assumption. In this analysis, it is assumed that the impulse response of the unknown system length is equal to the length of the finite impulse response (FIR) LMS adaptive filter. This research work suggests improving the MC and MSC of the adaptive filter, by replacing the fixed tap-length single long filter into a fixed tap-length multiple sub-filters/bank of sub-filters. The computer experimental simulation results illustrate to support the derived analysis.

articleTitle: Low-Profile, MIMO Antenna Based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide for WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile, MIMO antenna base on SIW structure for WLAN application was presented. The proposed antenna operates at 2.45 GHz with the measured impedance bandwidth (|S11|<; -10dB) of 4.9% (2.39-2.51 GHz). The input port isolation is better than 25 dB throughout the operating bandwidth. The antenna radiates in direction with peak gain ranging of 6.4 dBi at 2.45 GHz. The envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) is well below 0.02. The proposed antenna could be suitable for WLAN communication systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Load Allocation Problem Using Flower Pollination Algorithm with Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: The article presents flower pollination algorithm (FPA) algorithm which is applied on load scheduling problem with considering non-linear constraints like loading imbalance due to valve opening effect, ramp rate limit, forbidden zone etc. This algorithm is based on pollination process of flowers. The FPA is examined for 3-unit, 13-unit and 40-unit systems. Superioty of this algorithm has been proved by comparing results from other optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Estimation of HD3 and IM3 distortion for Fully-Differential Gm-C filter
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, Estimation of third-order harmonic and third-order intermodulation distortions for fully-differential Gm-C filter. It was found that the HD3 and IM3 distortion of the alternative structure FD first-order Gm-C filter are smaller than that of the classical structure. The analysis of circuit distortion in a less complicated based on the perturbation analysis of nonlinear distortion theory. The method was used to analyze the Gm-C filter circuit and to compare the results with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Velocity Detection by Ultrasonic Doppler based on Multi-Time Technique Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Experimental result of velocity measuring technique, namely, The ultrasonic Doppler, the technique employs a phase shift oscillator to be combination of signals for mixer replacement and tracks the Doppler frequency, is reported. The received ultrasonic signal was fed to the phase shift oscillator that generate 40.7 kHz of natural frequency as same as transmitted frequency. An output response of received ultrasonic present evidently in Doppler frequency which is proportional to velocity of object. Additionally, The great advantage of the multi-time technique could be used in order to predict its behavior. Measurement results verify the efficacy and agree well with analysis.

articleTitle: A Multiband Slot Antenna with the Fractal Narrow Slit fed by Capacitive Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presented a modifying fractal slit fed by capacitive coupling based on slot antenna for multiband operation. Two rectangular steps are added within a slot antenna. Also, the modified fractal slit is created by etching an inner rectangular stub fed by capacitive coupling. Then, the proposed antenna can be operated in multi band frequencies to support the wireless communication systems. The dimension of proposed antenna with this technique is smaller than conventional slot antenna about 23.6%. The |S11| levels of antenna are lower than -10 dB at the operating frequencies of 900 MHz, 1500 MHz, 1800 MHz, and 2.45 GHz, respectively. It can support the application of LoRa in IoT, GPS or GNSS system, 3G LTE 1800, and WiFi standard in IEEE 802.11 b/g at 2.45 GHz. The radiation patterns of the proposed antenna in every operating frequencies are bi-directional in XZ-planes and YZ-planes. Moreover, The antenna gain can achieved approximately 2.5 dBi.

articleTitle: Square/Triangular Wave Generator Using Single Bulk-Driven FDCCII
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents a new square/triangular wave generator based on ultra-low voltage fully differential second generation current conveyor (FDCCII). The circuit is composed base on Schmitt trigger and integrator circuits that employs one FDCCII, four resistors and one capacitor. The circuit can generate both square and triangular output waveforms into one topology. The performance of proposed circuit is confirmed using PSPICE simulations with a standard 0.18 μm CMOS process and with a 0.5 V supply.

Author Keywords: fully differential second generation current conveyor

articleTitle: Elimination of Differential-Mode Voltage in Dual-Inverter Drive Fed Open-End Winding Induction Motor Using PWM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents a vector control technique for a dual-inverter drive fed an open-end winding induction motor (OEW-IM) with a single dc source. In addition, a space vector modulation (SVM) method for the dual-inverter drive to eliminate the differential-mode voltage (DMV) is proposed by using the continuous and discontinuous modulating schemes. These two types of the modulation technique help in eliminating the DMV at the OEW-IM's terminal to mitigate the shaft voltage and bearing current of the OEM-IM. Both the vector control method and improved SVM schemes are carried out in a 0.37kW OEM-IM by means of a MATLAB/Simulink software. Simulation results are demonstrated and discussed to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method; consequently, not only the DMV but also the zero-sequence current of the dual-inverter drive system is fully suppressed.

articleTitle: A Wide-Supply-Voltage-Range CMOS Squarer
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper proposes a new CMOS squaring circuit. Its major advantage over common squaring circuits are that 1) it can operate at either low voltage supplies or ultra low voltage supplies. 2) the proposed circuit is free from body effect. If the circuit operates with low voltage supplies, all transistors will be biased in saturation region of strong inversion. Similarly if the circuit operates with ultra low voltage supplies, all transistors will be biased in saturation region of weak inversion. Simulation results are carried by spice program and agree well with theoretical anticipation.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Effect of Lactobacillus paracasei HII01 on Cortisol in Fatigue Subjects
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Fatigue is one of health illness issue in the world. It is developed from variety of factors. Stress is believed the main factor that induces fatigue. Stress is not only presented as fatigue symptom but also neuroendocrine alteration. The activation of Hypothalamus-Pituitary-Adrenal Axis (HPA-Axis) by stress impacts to cortisol level and induces inflammatory cytokine secretion. The activation of HPA-Axis induces gut microbiota alteration which is the causes of many mental and physical illnesses. Since stress-induced fatigue, it causes HPA-Axis activation and influences to gut microbiota alteration. Nonpharmacological approaches by probiotics consumption has numerous studies proving benefits on regulating HPA-Axis. The objective of the current study was to investigate benefits of probiotics supplementation (Lactobacillus paracasei HII01) on HPA-Axis by attenuating salivary cortisol level. Seven fatigue subjects (with an average age of 49.14 ± 17.74 years) were supplemented with 12.5 billion cells of L. paracasei HII01 per day for 12 weeks. After 12 weeks of intervention, the changes in cortisol level was calculated. Salivary cortisol level (from 224.07 ± 84.24 to 170.09 ± 63.23 ng/ml) was significantly decreased in the probiotic-supplemented group when compared to the baseline value. According to the results of the current study suggested that the supplementation of L. paracasei HII01 may attenuate salivary cortisol level and further studies are mandatory to reveal the health beneficial effect of the probiotic strain L. paracasei HII01.

articleTitle: The Harmonic Detection for Co-Phase Railway System in Distorted Voltage Source Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents the enhanced harmonic detection of active power filter (APF) for co-phase railway system in distorted voltage source condition. The instantaneous power theory (PQ) with positive sequence voltage detector (PSVD) is applied for the harmonic detection called PQ+PSVD algorithm. In the paper, the compensating current and DC bus voltage of the APF are controlled by the PI controller. The APFs and the proposed harmonic detection in co-phase traction power system are simulated using MATLAB/Simulink program. In distorted voltage condition, the simulation results show that the APFs with the proposed algorithm can keep a good performance for harmonic elimination. Moreover, the performance index (%THD) can also follow the IEEE std.519-2014.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Classification of Rose Apple Species and Their Qualities
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presented a method for classification of rose apples by applying deep learning algorithm. The deep learning was utilized in order to modeled the system for the analysis. The samples of rose apples that were used as an input for the system were based on their pictures. In order to create a deep learning model, Keras library with python language was used in this work. The great way to organize and manage the system was to collect as many samples as possible to increase the accuracy. Afterward, the database would be created to use for classifying the rose apples. The classification system in the work was set so that the accuracy was acceptable. As a result, the experiment showed that the system could produce an accuracy of 84.41% high. This simply concluded that the system performed at a high standard in the application for rose apple classification.

articleTitle: Analysis of Periodic Networks Using the Moment Method
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents the analysis of periodic networks using the moment method (MM). Numerical solutions are computed using associated integral equations and the point matching technique. Few examples of unit cells of periodically loaded transmission lines are considered to validate numerical solutions. It is found that numerical solutions are in excellent agreement with analytical solutions.

articleTitle: A Study of Partial Discharge Localization in Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Power breakdown in high voltage transformers are very critical problem which cause a serious loss to the related economy. Partial discharge is one of the causes that issue the power breakdown. To identify the partial discharge before the breakdown occur, there are different kind of method, such as UHF method, acoustic method and light phenomena. Since the various kind of material in transformer which made partial discharge localization become more difficult. To achieve high accuracy in partial discharge localization in power transformer the min-max technique and trilateration technique with time of arrival and received signal strength are introduce in this research paper. This paper focus on the partial discharge localization with UHF method which use the advantage of electromagnetic signal to find the partial discharge location. The set of microstrip patch antenna which operate in UHF bandwidth ranging from 1 GHz to 3 GHz are use as transmitter and receiver antenna. The measurement results are present by the cumulative distribution function of partial discharge localization distance error, to investigate the suitable technique and parameter for partial discharge localization in power transformer. From the result, the trilateration technique with time of arrival parameter is provide the most accuracy results than other technique and parameter.

articleTitle: Using Doppler Radar Classify Respiration by MFCC
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Respiration rate is an important parameter to indicate whether the respiratory system is normal or abnormal. In general, respiration rate can be calculated and counted the number of inhale and exhale when a person is in resting condition in 1 minute. There are many methods that can evaluate respiratory data from a various biomedical signal such as Electrocardiogram (ECG) Signals, Blood Pressure (BP) and Photo-plethysmography (PPG). But it can not be used in all condition like sleeping all night comfortably. According to all of the previous methods, they are all contact devices. Therefore, this paper studies non-contact respiration measured by using Doppler radar to receive the signal data, then use MFCC to extract the feature of the signal and feed the feature to DCNN. In the result, we got 85% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Slip Regulation Control of An Unsymmetrical Two-Phase Induction Motor Coupling with DC Generator Using Torque Control
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper proposes an unsymmetrical two-phase induction motor propulsion coupling with separately-excited DC generator by Matlab/Simulink. This propulsion composes of two parts. One is two-phase three-leg voltage source inverter by means of continuous unbalanced space vector pulse width modulation for the induction motor, which is controlled by slip regulation control. The other is four-quadrant DC chopper supplied with constant DC-link voltage of a three-phase grid-connected converter, which feed into armature winding of the DC generator using torque control. The simulation results was found that the induction motor was capable of constant speed at 1,450 rpm while taken load at 10 Nm with torque control of the four-quadrant DC chopper for DC generator. Furthermore, The DC generator was able to flow power to grid by the grid-connected converter. To conclude, the propulsion is good, since grid current in the generator drive part was nearly sinusoidal waveform and power in the same part can flow to grid, which can save energy and improve power factor.

Author Keywords: continuous unbalanced space vector pulse width modulation(CUSVPWM)

articleTitle: Simulation Evaluation of Noise Suppressing Technique Based on Decision Based Adaptive Median Filter for Salt&Pepper Noise
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Due to statistical characteristic, ROAD (Rank Order Absolute Difference) is one of the highest similar measurement performance in digital image for recognizing whether the impulsive noise pixel or the non-impulsive noise pixel whence the DBAMF (decision based adaptive median filter) was invented for suppressive an impulsive noise in 2010. As a result, the dissertation article aim to scrutinize the performance of the noise suppressing technique based on DBAMF under S&P noise. For evaluating the performance and its limitation of the noise suppressing technique based on DBAMF, the two assessment digital images constituted of Lena and Pepper are exploited in these simulation evaluations under SPN by initially disparaged by adding the impulsive noise (or SPN) at plentiful quantity. Next, each disparaged digital image is refined by the noise suppressing technique based on DBAMF. Moreover, the refined image is confronted with the refined image from the classical SMF (Standard Median Filter) and AMF (Adaptive Median Filter) for proving the DBAMF performance from quantitative indicator perspective.

Author Keywords: Digital Image Denoising SMF (Standard Median Filter)

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Effect of Lactobacillus Paracasei on High-Density and Low-Density Lipoproteins Level in Hypercholesterolemic Patients
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Probiotics are defined as “live microorganisms, that when administered in suitable amounts, confer a health benefit on the host”. The evidence for the health benefits of probiotics has been increased in recent decades. Hypercholesterolemia is a major risk factor for the development of cardiovascular diseases. Several pharmacological and dietary approaches are proposed and used to reduce the cholesterol level. Though a number of drugs are currently in use to treat hypercholesterolemia, it has several undesirable side effects. The objective of the current study was to study the effect of probiotic supplementation (Lactobacillus paracasei) on high-density lipoprotein (HDL), and low-density lipoprotein (LDL) level in hypercholesterolemic patients. Seven hypercholesterolemic subjects (with an average age of 46.14 ± 18.34 years) were supplemented with 12.5 billion cells of L. paracasei per day for 12 weeks. After 12 weeks of intervention, the changes in HDL and LDL level was calculated. Both HDL (from 61.14 ± 9.65 to 67.29 ± 7.99 mg/DL) and LDL (from 141.57 ± 31.95 to 126.29 ± 36.23 mg/DL) levels were significantly changed in the probiotic-supplemented group when compared to the baseline value. The results of the current study suggested that the supplementation of L. paracasei may help to reduce the hypercholesterolemia, and further studies are mandatory to reveal the health beneficial effect of the probiotic strain L. paracasei.

articleTitle: High Step-up Push-Pull Resonant Converter Based on Current Source Class-D Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents high step-up push-pull resonant converter based on current source class-D rectifier, it provides high of voltage for a 12 V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC</sub> from battery via isolated transformer and current source class-D Rectifier. The main switches of push-pull and diode full-bridge rectifier operated under zero current switching condition. The advantaged this technique is used leakage inductance for zero current switching of power switch and leakage inductance used designing resonant tank secondary side. A prototype high step-up push-pull resonant converter was built and operated at a 200 kHz fixed switching frequency, a rate 340 V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC</sub> output voltage and 250 W output power. The objective analysis the effect of parasitic junction capacitance of full-bridge rectifier which has significant impact of this purpose is to operating point of resonant tank and voltage. The circuit proposed and designed was verify by experimental result. From a result are presented in agreement with the theoretical analysis and experimental work.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Embedded Networked Wireless Digital Controller for Multiple Plants using Bit-Representation Data Formation
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper proposes some powerful techniques to design and development data packages used for multiple plants embedded wireless digital controller. The system performs data exchanging using master-slave topology, the common one in industrial automation systems. The master and slaves are implemented on low-cost IoT-supported 32-bit microcontroller. The Free-RTOS is used as real-time operating system. All drivers of the master and slave controllers are implemented using C language and mainly preforms bitwise operations to obtain the speed and efficiency of the code execution. The plants used in this research are brushed dc-motors driven by PWM-based bidirectional H-bridge drivers. There are four types of the data packages are proposed. The data packages are designed using bit-representation data formation techniques. The data package design technique requires only one byte for the package header. It can reduce numbers of bytes of data exchanged over network. To archive the real-time control and monitoring capabilities of the system, the WebSockets protocol is selected implemented in all devices, master, slaves and computer. In addition, the proposed system is also evaluated on other protocols, the HTTP and MQTT. The experimental results show that the proposed techniques, system design and data package design, can perform on all communication protocols, no package loss. Using the WebSockets as communication protocol can archive the real-time capability of the system. It means that the proposed system can be implemented in real-world applications, the industrial real-time control monitoring and control systems.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Control by Tangible programming for Developmenting of Computer Scientist Thinking skill in Elementary School
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Generally, programming for controlling mobile robot is difficult for children in the elementary school. Such program is unsuitable for children or novices as they cannot understand how to use the program. This research seeks to present tangible programming for develop of computer scientist thinking skill for children. Normally, this idea taught at university or college level. This may be late as far as acquiring knowledge in the future. The program could be use in elementary schools. Using tangible programming control mobile robot without a computer or tablet which this encourages children to learn. Simple concept for idea open-loop control systems and close-loop control systems. In this research children can understand idea concrete. Another tangible programming for control mobile robot present idea programming 2 conditions: 1) sequential command 2) conditions for changing the status of the mobile robot. In the future tangible programming for control mobile robot will change learning and idea to children in development of computer scientist thinking.

articleTitle: Brain Exercise in Elderly People by Neurosky Smarter Kit
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to study the use of Neurosky Smarter Kit in brain exercise training program on both attention and meditation levels' changes in elderly. The sample of this study were nine participants, which were four men and ten women, aged 61-84 years old. All participants were measured their attention and meditation levels by Neurosky Smarter Kit prior to the brain training program. During the training, should any participant could not proceed to the next session, he/she was measured their attention and meditation levels again. They were allowed to break for fifteen to thirty minutes or as much as they needed. Then, the second brain training was done and that participants were measured their attention and meditation levels again. The result showed that attention and meditation levels were gradually increased with no statistically significant. Both theta and alpha brainwaves were increased statistically significant.

articleTitle: Shared Control Strategies for BCI-based Quadcopter Control
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to propose a shared control strategy for improving the performance and stability of brain-computer interface (BCI)-based quadcopter movement control. With the advancement of brain imaging devices that are inexpensive, non-invasive, and portable, BCI has recently been implemented in various control applications, for example, wheelchair, telepresence robot, robotic manipulator arm, and quadcopter can be controlled using BCI-based motor imagery task or mental arithmetic task. However, using BCI modalities is still difficult to control a movement of the abovementioned machines with high stability and accuracy. Shared control is a technique that combines inputs and environment information of the system, and then, these inputs will be processed to achieve high efficient output. In this paper, the concept of the shared control will be proposed in three different methods: distance measurement sensor, eye movement detection and Global Positioning System (GPS) for avoiding an obstacle of BCI-based quadcopter control.

articleTitle: The Graphics and Physics Engines for Rapid Development of 3D Web-based Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents an engine that provides graphics and physics capabilities. It can be used as a powerful library for modern real-time 3D realistic WebGLbased 3D applications. There are two main parts proposed in this research. The first one is Engine Core, the graphics and physics engines. The second one is Engine APIs, the Application Programming Interfaces of the proposed engine. The Engine APIs provides all required functions to create the 3D graphics and physics applications running on web-browser. All modules of the proposed engine are written in modern JavaScript (ES6) and transpired to common JavaScript (CJS). It means that the transpired engine can be integrated in the webpage and run on target web-browser directly. In addition, this paper provides some other meaningful information to readers who are interesting in web-based 3D graphics and physics applications, e.g., Blender modeling techniques, the glTF model exporting and complex shape assets and their colliders creation techniques.

articleTitle: Analysis of The 115/22 kV Transformer Fault Tripping using Fault Tree Analysis based on Python Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: The 115/22 kV transformer is a significant equipment to transmit the energy to the customers. The power outage occurred, if there was a transformer tripping. The control center operator has to identify the severity of alarms on SCADA while the event occurred, by indicating the transformer tripping and how many events of the power outages, in order to quickly transfer the electrical load to other transformer. The process explained above, the operator would require less time to reduce the impact of power outage. Therefore, this paper proposes the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Fault Tree Analysis on Python Platform. It was developed to be as a substitute for operators work in analyzing the message alarm. This paper also presents the determination of the previous loads by Weighted Moving Average technique. This technique was used in planning to transfer the load from the transformer outage to another and can prevent the power overload event on the power system. Moreover, this article presents an automatically tripping event reported via Line application. All information was sent to distribution company control center and maintenance staff. As a result, AI can replace control center operator work. AI can more accurately identify the severity of alarms that occurred simultaneously than operator. AI also spends only 12 seconds which is less than the operator spends at388 seconds.

articleTitle: IoT in Pre-Analytical Phase of Breast Cancer Specimens Handling in Thailand Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Using chemotherapy in a breast cancer patient, resulting in a greatly suffer in patients from the side effect. The key factor in a selection of breast cancer treatment method depends on diagnostic reports from a pathology laboratory, which correlate to a pre-analytical process of breast cancer specimens handling. Since the process is still lack of a formalin fixation time monitoring tool, the prototype based on the internet of things (IoTs) is proposed in this work. From a practical implementation in Khon Kaen province, it is found that the prototype can monitor a fixation time good enough as well as an integrated notification function when a fixation time exceeds the golden period.

articleTitle: A 1.5 V, 50 nA, 100 Hz, 73 dB-DR, Subthreshold Lowpass Filter for EEG/ECG Recording
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents a subthreshold lowpass biquad circuit suitable for the design of EEG/ECG Lowpass filter. The proposed circuit is designed to obtain an input referred noise of 25 p.V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</sub> and a cutoff frequency of 100 Hz. Circuit simulations, using 0.35 micron CMOS model parameters, verify that the filter operated from a 1.5 V single supply consumes 75 nW and provides a dynamic range of 73 dB (measured from 1% total harmonic distortion) well compatible to EEG and ECG acquisition requirements.

articleTitle: Speech Recognition Approach using Descend-Delta-Mean and MFCC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, we present the improving the feature extraction method of the MFCC algorithm for noise robustness when there is interference in the speech input signal. The various parameter extraction with new technique as the descend-delta-mean and mel frequency cepstral coefficients is called the DDMMFCC. The purpose is to require the noise robustness of feature vector extracted from the speech signal with the characteristic coefficients of the DDM-MFCC algorithm. In order to increase the speech and speakers recognition accuracy rate, the DDM technique is a new method of finding the average value of a descendant of power spectrum magnitude. The process consisting method of rearranging magnitude of the spectral power is reduced to a minimum in each frequency band of the speech signal, and to find the difference in the arrangement. Finally, to determine the value of mean. The experiment results of the proposed robustness feature extraction DDM-MFCC algorithm and the conventional of MFCC algorithm is compared, when the training and testing dataset is the 0-9 Isolated THAI digits speech of 10 THAI speakers recognition. With additive random white Gaussian noise is added for testing dataset with signal to noise ratio (SNR) as 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20 dB, respectively. Simulation results of proposed DMM-MFCC algorithm are shown higher rate of recognition accuracy rate than the conventional MFCC algorithm.

articleTitle: Metamaterial-Based Temperature Sensor Comprised of VO2 Nano-Ribbons
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Vanadium dioxide (VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>)-based temperature sensor is investigated under optical incidence. The proposed device is comprised of metamaterial which incorporates a periodic array of VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nano-ribbons mounted over stacked multilayers of aluminum oxide (Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) and silicon dioxide (SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>). The essence of the proposed design is the temperature-dependence property of the permittivity of VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> medium that constitutes the top metasurface. Attenuated reflection characteristics of the structure are investigated. The sensing feature of proposed configuration is analyzed in term of shifts in reflection minima corresponding to changes in ambient temperature.

articleTitle: Novel Circulating Current Control of Direct Parallel PWM Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This paper presents a new method of eliminating the circulating currents that occur in the directly parallel converters (DPC), while each converter supplies an unequal current. The paper proposes the new model of the converter in 0-axis using Fourier transforms and separating the models in 0-axis to 0d- and 0<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>-axis. The new model designs the circulating current controller (CCC) to control the modulation signal of each converter in the DPC to be equal, which will result in no circulating current flow between the converters. From the simulation results, it can be confirmed that the proposed model can work like the average model used in general. And by simulation, it can be seen that the proposed CCC can control the circulating current in DPC to zero, although each of the converters that are direct paralleled will supply many different currents. In addition, the current generated from each converter is also sinusoidal.

articleTitle: Joint Timing Offset and Delay Spread Estimation for OFDM Symbol Synchronization over Multipath Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, we present a blind symbol timing offset estimation utilizing cyclic prefix for OFDM systems over multipath fading channels without a priori knowledge of the channel power-delay profile being required. The proposed technique is based on maximum likelihood (ML) principle which is capable of estimating jointly symbol timing offset and channel power-delay spread. Numerical results obtained through computer simulations show that our proposed technique can be effective in comparison to other techniques for additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and multipath fading channels.

articleTitle: Effects of Synbiotic Supplement in Thai Smokers: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: This study proposes the effect of synbiotic supplement on gut-brain axis in Thai smokers in the realm of gut-related biochemical parameters and cognition. We conducted a single group, pre- and post-test study; 20 patients lived in Mahasarakham, Fagerstrom Test for Nicotine Dependence at 4 or above, and no history of cerebrovascular diseases, brain and abdominal surgery, and not taking hormones or drugs influenced brainwaves or using antibiotics within two weeks before. Subjects were assigned to intake synbiotic supplement containing 3 types of prebiotics and 7 species of probiotics once a day before bedtime for 8 weeks. Outcomes were measured in gut-related biochemical parameters change and alternation in cognition. The current results have shown significantly decrease in the scores of Fagerstrom test for nicotine dependence and also the scores of craving for smoke after intervention. Further studies are mandatory to conduct in finding a tendency to improve in gut-related biochemical parameter and cognition after intake of synbiotic supplement.

articleTitle: Distributed Frequency Suppression Method using Inverter for Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, the frequency variation suppression method for dispersed photovoltaic power generation (PV) is proposed. The variation of system frequency can occur due to the shortage of power generator adjustment under the massive installation of PV. In addition, the PV which is not equipped with frequency control results in the system frequency change. To handle this problem, a frequency control method by giving generator constants to distributed PVs is presented. Since, the distributed PVs cannot exchange information such as power generation amount and solar radiation amount etc., only the capacity of distributed PV is used. As a result, the generator constants of each PV can be calculated, and the frequency control can be performed. Study results confirm that the power generation output of PV which changes momentarily can be supplemented by giving the generator constants to distributed PVs.

articleTitle: The Designation of the Lightning Protection for the Photovoltaic Module by using the Protective Angle Method
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Nowadays, the natural fuel cell is continuously decreased. Therefore, the PV module can be utilized to generate the renewable energy for the electrical applications. However, the PV module will be installed at the outdoor areas which directly risk to strike by the lightning flash. Hence, it must be protected the lightning flash by using the lightning protection apparatus. Moreover, the lightning protection apparatus such as the air termination can deliver the result of the lightning protection angle based on the protective angle method which can be utilized to protect the lightning hazard for the PV module. However, the analysis of the lightning protection angle is complicated for implementation with the PV module because it never appears the simplified correlation. As mentioned above, this article presents the designation of the lightning protection for the PV module by using the protective angle method. The lightning protection angle protecting for the PV module is analyzed through the novel equation which is easily determined the result for the practical. Moreover, the procedure of the designation in this article can be utilized in the implementation.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Fuzzy PID Controller optimized by ALO Algorithm in AGC
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this work, the parallel combination of PID and fuzzy PID controllers entitled as Intelligent fuzzy PID (IFPID) controller is validated as a superior controller over PID and fuzzy PID controllers for two area thermal power system as Automatic Generation Control (AGC). The parameters of controllers implemented in the power system are tuned by Ant Lion Optimizer (ALO). The validation of novelty of controller and algorithm are graded by concerning the response parameters such as undershoot, overshoot, and settling time of deviations (frequency and power). A load disturbance of 0.01 p.u. is implemented in area-1 to demonstrate the whole experiment. Finally, IFPID controller optimized by ALO algorithm contributes better performance over PID and fuzzy PID controllers as AGC.

articleTitle: Prediction of Production Performance for Tapioca Industry using LSTM neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Cyber-physical system (CPS) is integrated between the virtual and physical worlds that uses service-oriented architecture (SOA) to manage service objects such as production, quality control, and maintenance engineering. Moreover, the CPS will be more effective by using the predictive ability to integrate some service object of CPS. This paper presents an intelligence function on the top CPS platform which will be the prediction of production performance to detect yield malfunction by using affect parameter with a starch yield of each production units such as production rate, starch content, loss in the process, a temperature of the flash dryer, and moisture content of starch for adjust the production process before an actual failure situation. The prediction model uses historian data from the factory with data from a mass balance model simulation and uses a Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) processing to get the yield predicted results to indicate the trend of change in yield or irregularities that may occur, which will be the information for the design or modification of the production plan or control the production to be appropriate before abnormalities in real situations. This model has an average accuracy of 90.55% of test dataset which is predicted 1 day in advance.

articleTitle: Implementation of 3-D Multiple Linear Regression in Hardware using the Xilinx Spartan-3AN FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this paper, a linear regression algorithm implementation in hardware using the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is presented. A two-dimensional (2-D) simple linear regression aims to develop a linear equation of two variables based on observed data values in two dimensions. A more complex problem that this considered in this paper is the three-dimensional (3-D) multiple linear regression that approximates a linear equation of three variables based on a set of observed data points in three dimensions. The algorithm was initially modelled and verified using Python, NumPy and Matplotlib. The linear regression equation was then translated to hardware using a VHDL description of the algorithm targeting the Xilinx Spartan-3AN FPGA. In this paper, the design and simulation of the algorithm based on using the available hardware resources within the FPGA are introduced and discussed.

articleTitle: Thermal Behavior of FDM 3D Printing by Using Arduino Mega 2560 Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Nowadays, 3D printing technology has gained rapid popularity in the field of product design and material design. It creates tangible objects that replace defective materials immediately upon the properties of the nozzles and raw materials. It is different from conventional printers with limited printouts in document format. The problem of 3D printers is very hard of optimization control and complicated to material. This research aims to propose the thermal and dynamic speed that suitable for printing. The main goal is printing quality control of Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) 3D printers with PLA plastic lines from the thermal nozzle controlled by the Arduino Mega 2560 that compare the performance and quality of prints from the control of each format. The results show that efficiency and quality of printing at a reasonable speed of 30 mm/s. The heat for the molten PLA plastic line at the nozzle is suitably 170o C that bending stresses at 63 MPa. The recommend of this experiment is that increasing heat and speed significant effect on the efficiency and quality of the work piece.

articleTitle: Vehicle Sensors Programming Based On Controller Area Network (CAN) Bus Using Canoe
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Controller Area Network (CAN) is a network that allows communication between ECUs in a vehicle by introducing a cheaper and light-weight communication medium. CAN is an asynchronous protocol yet provides efficient synchronous mechanism. Therefore, it is crucial to make sure the message transmission in CAN bus is accurate and does not miss its deadline. Local Interconnect Network (LIN) bus, is widely adopted as an alternative and additive bus protocol that has been used to complement CAN. In this project, the objective is to investigate the performance of the CAN signal generated from CAN simulator - CANOE, with and without the integration LIN. Moreover, this paper aims to observe the difference between these two different methods of signal transmission. As to create an experiment environment with the CAN and LIN simulation, the KWP Diagnostic Tester is created. Based on the established model, 4 cases have been introduced to create 4 different test environments, to showcase the different type of data transmission. It is shown that the CAN has an improved average of 2.7% on the transmission speed compared to CAN+LIN.

articleTitle: Development of Optical Receiver Device with Frequency Response Model for Radio-over-Fiber Link
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: The development of optical receiver configuration as a Small Outline Integrated Circuit (SOIC) photodiode array on a single plastic-encapsulate chipset is achieved and it can be used to replace a conventional photodiode in RoF link to improve the link gain and Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) of the link at the optical receiver side. This allows us to simultaneously drive photodiodes from 1 to 5 on a single chip and investigate the RF link performance in terms of frequency response at different sets of photodiodes. The results show that the link gain (S21) or frequency response of RoF link can be measured to be -51, -49, -48, -47 and -46 dB at 600 MHz for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 driven photodiodes respectively. This confirms that with the use of 5 photodiodes, the link gain can be improved by 5 dB. Then, the frequency response models of 2 and 3 photodiodes of SOIC photodiode array are firstly created on ADS software and confirmed that they are close to the measurement results.

articleTitle: Power Development Planning considering Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Power development plan or PDP is a long-term plan for energy reliability and security. It illustrates how much power plant a country plans to build to meet future demand. At present, one of the great challenges for the system planner is to develop a PDP that can confront with high growth of demand as well as high growth of the renewable energy. As the renewable energy is highly penetrated, it creates high uncertainty and intermittency to the power grid in such a way that, sometimes, typical conventional power plant cannot be quick enough to response. Many recent researches suggest that the energy storage system or ESS should be installed to cope with this problem. This paper proposed a method to develop a PDP considering installation of the ESS. The key factor determining whether a power grid requires a new plant or a new ESS is an index modified from Reserved Margin (RM). To illustrate the advantage of the proposed method, new power development plan (PDP) done by the proposed method is then compared to the Thailand's current plan, PDP2018.

articleTitle: Improving Plagiarism Checker Throughput with Apache Storm
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: At present, accessing and publishing new knowledge are much easier than they were in the past. This has given rise to a “copy-and-paste” culture, which is a violation of intellectual property. A plagiarism checker can help to identify such incident. Unfortunately, existing plagiarism checkers still do not offer services that handle many users at once like what Google's do. We conjecture that there is a bottleneck that they still need to overcome before making their adoption more widespread. This paper proposes a framework to improve the throughput of existing plagiarism checkers to tackle the bottleneck in question. Our framework leverages stream processing via Apache Storm. It can be tailored to meet throughput specification with additional computational resources that grow linearly with the increase in throughput.

articleTitle: Antenna Gain Self-calibration for Double Ridged Guide Horn Antenna using Bi-directional Optical Fiber Link Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: We have previously proposed an antenna gain self-calibration method for broadband antennas using the time-domain and averaging techniques. For the antenna gain measurement using our proposed method, the reflection coefficients for the antenna under test are measured using a vector network analyzer and a coaxial cable. Therefore, the measured results include the influence of the coaxial cable. The present study evaluates and eliminates the influence of the coaxial cable for the antenna gain self-calibration method by performing the antenna gain measurement for a double ridged guide horn antenna using a bi-directional optical fiber link transceiver. This study shows that we can estimate the antenna gain without the coaxial cable effect using our developed optical fiber link transceiver.

articleTitle: Comparison of the GNSS Position Accuracy on Mobile Phones in Vientiane, Laos
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: In this research, the position errors derived from Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals of two different brands of smart phones are assessed. To perform the experiment, two smartphones Samsung Galaxy Note 8 and Google Pixel 1 have been chosen. The main goal of this test is to compare the position accuracy of each phone. As different environments such as open-sky or partially blocked view affect the received satellite signal levels; therefore, we made the test by recording the GNSS signals in crowded city areas, where many buildings can be found, and open areas, where there are no obstructions. The raw data are processed using the recently available open-source software named Google Analysis Tools. The results show that the received GPS signal in the clear environment have lower errors and more accurate than in the city environment. It can be seen that Galaxy Note 8 has the ability to locate places better (less error values) than Google Pixel.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation and Bit Loading for WPM with Time-Domain MMSE Equalization
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Wavelet Packet Modulation (WPM) is a Multi-Carrier Modulation (MCM) technique considered as a possible substitute for Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). Unlike OFDM, symbols of WPM overlap in the time domain, preventing the use Cyclic Prefix (CP) for equalization. This paper uses Minimum-Mean Square Error (MMSE) equalization for WPM considering unknown Channel State Information (CSI). A channel estimation method is proposed based on solving an overdetermined system of linear equations. The Channel Impulse Response (CIR) is estimated using a training sequence. The estimated CIR is used for bit loading that considers limitations of MMSE equalization such as noise amplification and signal attenuation. Numerical results based on quasistatic channels with Rayleigh fading demonstrate that the Bit Error Rate (BER) for WPM is lowered with the proposed bit loading. In addition, with unknown CSI, WPM with bit loading outperforms OFDM with bit loading.

articleTitle: Multi-Polar Radio Frequency Combined with Pulse Electromagnetic Field and Vacuum System for Cellulite and Circumference Reduction
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Cellulite is skin condition. Cellulite can be found 8090% of post-pubertal women, it looks like orange peel skin. Often found in thighs and buttock regions. The prevalence of cellulite had led to many attempts at treatment including surgery, massage, topical solution or medical device for cellulite reduction. The purpose of study was to evaluate the efficiency of combination device involving multi-polar radiofrequency, pulsed electromagnetic field and vacuum system for treatment cellulite. Method: 9 subjects with Nurnberger – Muller Scale 2 upper thighs cellulite, were entered into study. All subjects were treated 8 treatments (2 times/week) with combination device. All subjects were evaluated before, after 4 treatment, after 8 treatment and follow up 4 weeks after last treatment with clinical photographs, circumference measurement and skinfold measurement. Result: Cellulite with circumference size and skinfold thickness was reduced after treatment course. Clinical photography showed evidence of clinical improvement. After last treatment 4 weeks, the treatment results remain. Combination multi-polar radiofrequency, pulsed electromagnetic field and vacuum system technology prolonged beneficial effect on the reduction of upper thighs circumference and skinfold thickness and cellulite appearance. Maintenance treatments may be necessary to further enhance the clinical results achieved.

articleTitle: A Study of Optical Properties of Thin Film Polymer Spin-Coated with Different Dispensing Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 16th International Conference on Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer, Telecommunications and Information Technology (ECTI-CON)
abstract: Thin films of poly(methyl methacrylate), PMMA, were fabricated by using a spin-coating process with two different dispensing methods: static and dynamic ones. In the former and latter methods, the solution was dropped onto the substrate when the substrate was stationary and spinning, respectively. The films were characterised for their optical transmittance. The results show that the films from the dynamic dispensing method would provide higher optical transmittances than those from the static ones, indicating the thinner films.
